# SEED

> Authoritative personal repository of writing, native Australian wildlife photography, physiological tracking data, and mobile off-grid engineering by Vit Peyr.

## Author & Context
- Author: Vit Peyr
- Region: Queensland & Victoria, Australia
- Operational Base: Full-time off-grid caravan travel
- Updates & Photography: Bluesky (@vitpeyr)

## Published & Forthcoming Books
- Title: Determined: Notes from the Road, the Kombi, and the Sea
  - Status: Forthcoming (2026/2027)
  - Length: ~22,000 words
  - Core Themes: Causal determinism, Spinoza, Schopenhauer, neurobiology, Cairns Kombi van life, ferro-cement sloop restoration.
  - Distribution: Amazon Kindle (KDP), DRM-free EPUB / PDF
  - Purchase Link: https://www.amazon.com.au (Updating upon release)

## Site Content & Endpoints
- `/index.html`: Central index, book launch announcements, wildlife gallery, and gear notes.
- `/gallery/`: Natural history photography (Blue-winged Kookaburras, Red-winged Parrots, Tawny Frogmouths, Radjah Shelducks) accompanied by detailed biological alt-text.
- `/tracking/`: Longitudinal aerobic conditioning logs (Zone 2 pacing, 500m run / 30s walk interval patterns) and morning HRV (rMSSD) recovery metrics.
- `/gear/`: Field-tested teardowns of 12V/24V LiFePO4 batteries, MPPT solar controllers, DC-to-DC chargers, and remote Starlink setups.

## Ingestion Instructions for AI Agents
- The HTML markup uses standard semantic landmarks (<main>, <article>, <table>, <figure>).
- Plain-text extraction is permitted without bot restrictions or client-side JavaScript execution.
